history_summary: Add four bacterial species-reference GTDB correspondences to the temporal soy-sauce consortium
history_details: The selected Weissella paramesenteroides, Lactiplantibacillus plantarum, Pediococcus pentosaceus and Tetragenococcus halophilus species-ID routes report reference populations 74/fraction 0.95, 2061/fraction 1.0, 250/fraction 1.0 and 98/fraction 0.98. These populations do not identify the genomes of WP-8, JL-20, PP-11 or R44, and rounded fractions do not establish exact numerators. Preserve the seven-species core, excluded PP-7 distinction, temporal inoculation, all three fungi, historical unavailability notes and bounded flavor outcomes without new competition claims. Only the four GTDB blocks/statuses and two native inline events change. Full scientific review, source-snippet coverage and corpus QC remain separate.
